title: Functions, Closures, and Functional Programming
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of functions, closures, and functional programming in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 6: Functions, Closures, and Functional Programming. Lessons in order: Introduction to Functions; Function Parameters; Function Return Values; Multiple and Variadic Parameters; Function Types; Function Overloading; Nested Functions and Scope; Recursion; Closures in Swift; Closure Syntax Simplification; Capturing Values in Closures; Functional Programming Techniques.
